arxiv-2105-13333.title: Optimized diamond inverted nanocones for enhanced color center to fiber coupling
arxiv-2105-13333.creator: Cem Güney Torun, Philipp-Immanuel Schneider, Martin Hammerschmidt, Sven Burger, Joseph H.D. Munns, Tim Schröder
arxiv-2105-13333.description: Abstract Nanostructures can be used for boosting the light outcoupling of color centers in diamond; however, the fiber coupling performance of these nanostructures is rarely investigated. Here, we use a finite element method for computing the emission from color centers in inverted nanocones and the overlap of this emission with the propagation mode in a single-mode fiber.

arxiv-2106-15181.title: A Dyson Sphere around a black hole 2021 A Dyson Sphere around a black hole – References
arxiv-2106-15181.creator: Tiger Yu-Yang Hsiao, Tomotsugu Goto, Tetsuya Hashimoto, Daryl Joe D. Santos, Alvina Y. L. On, Ece Kilerci-Eser, Yi Hang Valerie Wong, Seong Jin Kim, Cossas K.-W. Wu, Simon C.-C. Ho, Ting-Yi Lu
arxiv-2106-15181.description: Abstract The search for extraterrestrial intelligence (SETI) has been conducted for nearly 60 years. A Dyson Sphere, a spherical structure that surrounds a star and transports its radiative energy outward as an energy source for an advanced civilisation, is one of the main targets of SETI.

arxiv-2204-06171.title: Self-Supervised Traffic Advisors: Distributed, Multi-view Traffic Prediction for Smart Cities
arxiv-2204-06171.creator: Jiankai Sun, Shreyas Kousik, David Fridovich-Keil, Mac Schwager
arxiv-2204-06171.description: Abstract Connected and Autonomous Vehicles (CAVs) are becoming more widely deployed, but it is unclear how to best deploy smart infrastructure to maximize their capabilities. One key challenge is to ensure CAVs can reliably perceive other agents, especially occluded ones.

arxiv-2204-08797.title: Two-Stream Graph Convolutional Network for Intra-oral Scanner Image Segmentation
arxiv-2204-08797.creator: Yue Zhao, Lingming Zhang, Yang Liu, Deyu Meng, Zhiming Cui, Chenqiang Gao, Xinbo Gao, Chunfeng Lian, Dinggang Shen
arxiv-2204-08797.description: Abstract Precise segmentation of teeth from intra-oral scanner images is an essential task in computer-aided orthodontic surgical planning. The state-of-the-art deep learning-based methods often simply concatenate the raw geometric attributes (i.e., coordinates and normal vectors) of mesh cells to train a single-stream network for automatic intra-oral scanner image segmentation.

arxiv-2208-05123.title: Collective spin modes in Fermi liquids with spin-orbit coupling
arxiv-2208-05123.creator: Dmitrii L. Maslov, Abhishek Kumar, Saurabh Maiti
arxiv-2208-05123.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Dmitrii L. Maslov, Abhishek Kumar, Saurabh Maiti. A combination of spin-orbit coupling and electron-electron interaction gives rise to a new type of collective spin modes, which correspond to oscillations of magnetization even in the absence of the external magnetic field.

arxiv-2302-06187.title: Quantum diamond magnetometry for navigation in GNSS denied environments
arxiv-2302-06187.creator: Xuezhi Wang, Wenchao Li, Bill Moran, Brant C. Gibson, Liam T. Hall, David Simpson, Allison N. Kealy, Andrew D. Greentree
arxiv-2302-06187.description: Abstract Satellite-based navigation is a transformational technology that underpins almost all aspects of modern life. However, there are environments where global navigation satellite systems (GNSS) are not available, for example undersea or underground, and navigation that is robust to GNSS outages is also required for resilient systems.

arxiv-2304-09302.title: CabiNet: Scaling Neural Collision Detection for Object Rearrangement with Procedural Scene Generation
arxiv-2304-09302.creator: Adithyavairavan Murali, Arsalan Mousavian, Clemens Eppner, Adam Fishman, Dieter Fox
arxiv-2304-09302.description: Abstract We address the important problem of generalizing robotic rearrangement to clutter without any explicit object models. We first generate over 650K cluttered scenes—orders of magnitude more than prior work—in diverse everyday environments, such as cabinets and shelves. We render synthetic partial point clouds from this data and use it to train our CabiNet model architecture.

arxiv-2511-01203.title: FEval-TTC: Fair Evaluation Protocol for Test-Time Compute
arxiv-2511-01203.creator: Pavel Rumiantsev, Soumyasundar Pal, Yingxue Zhang, Mark Coates
arxiv-2511-01203.description: Abstract The performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) and the associated dollar costs of API calls can fluctuate over time, potentially invalidating conclusions drawn in prior research. To address this, we propose a F air Eval uation protocol for T est- T ime C ompute (FEval-TTC), designed to ensure consistent assessment of test-time compute (TTC) methods, regardless of such fluctuations.

pmc-10530364.title: Mechanosensitive Ion Channels: Their Physiological Importance and Potential Key Role in Cancer
pmc-10530364.creator: Álvaro Otero-Sobrino, Pablo Blanco-Carlón, Miguel Ángel Navarro-Aguadero, Miguel Gallardo, Joaquín Martínez-López, María Velasco-Estévez
pmc-10530364.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Mechanosensitive ion channels comprise a broad group of proteins that sense mechanical extracellular and intracellular changes, translating them into cation influx to adapt and respond to these physical cues. All cells in the organism are mechanosensitive, and these physical cues have proven to have an important role in regulating proliferation, cell fate and differentiation, migration and cellular stress, among other processes.

pmc-10654734.title: Predictive biomarkers of response and survival following immunotherapy with a PD-L1 inhibitor benmelstobart (TQB2450) and antiangiogenic therapy with a VEGFR inhibitor anlotinib for pretreated advanced triple negative breast cancer
pmc-10654734.creator: Yiqun Han, Jiayu Wang, Tao Sun, Quchang Ouyang, Jianwen Li, Jie Yuan, Binghe Xu
pmc-10654734.description: In our phase Ib trial (ClinialTrials.gov Identifier: NCT03855358), benmelstobart (TQB2450), a novel humanized IgG1 antibody against PD-L1, plus antiangiogenic multikinase inhibitor, anlotinib, demonstrated promising antitumor activities in pretreated triple negative breast cancer (TNBC) patients. We conducted explorative analyses of genomic biomarkers to explore the associations with treatment response and survival outcomes.

pmc-11476764.title: Transcriptomic and Metabolomic Profiling of Root Tissue in Drought-Tolerant and Drought-Susceptible Wheat Genotypes in Response to Water Stress
pmc-11476764.creator: Ling Hu, Xuemei Lv, Yunxiu Zhang, Wanying Du, Shoujin Fan, Lingan Kong, Abir U Igamberdiev
pmc-11476764.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Wheat is the most widely grown crop in the world; its production is severely disrupted by increasing water deficit. Plant roots play a crucial role in the uptake of water and perception and transduction of water deficit signals. In the past decade, the mechanisms of drought tolerance have been frequently reported; however, the transcriptome and metabolome regulatory network of root responses to water stress has not been fully understood in wheat.

pmc-11508216.title: Thermal Conductivity Enhancement of Doped Magnesium Hydroxide for Medium-Temperature Heat Storage: A Molecular Dynamics Approach and Experimental Validation
pmc-11508216.creator: Anti Kur, Jo Darkwa, Mark Worall, John Calautit, Rabah Boukhanouf, Qingwei Liao, Xiuyu Wang
pmc-11508216.description: Magnesium hydroxide, Mg(OH)2, is recognized as a promising material for medium-temperature heat storage, but its low thermal conductivity limits its full potential application. In this study, thermal enhancement of a developed magnesium hydroxide-potassium nitrate (Mg(OH)2-KNO3) material was carried out with aluminum oxide (Al2O3) nanomaterials.

pmc-11531520.title: Meditation dosage predicts self- and teacher-perceived responsiveness to an 18-month randomised controlled trial
pmc-11531520.creator: Marco Schlosser, Julie Gonneaud, Stefano Poletti, Romain Bouet, Olga M. Klimecki, Fabienne Collette, Natalie L. Marchant, Gaël Chételat, Antoine Lutz, Claire André, Claire André, Florence Allais, Julien Asselineau, Eider Arenaza-Urquijo, Sebastian Baez, Martine Batchelor, Axel Beaugonin, Maelle Bott
pmc-11531520.description: Understanding the factors that predict why some individuals perceive to respond more to meditation training than others could impact the development, efficacy, adherence levels, and implementation of meditation-based interventions. We investigated individual-level variables associated with self- and teacher-perceived responsiveness to longer-term meditation training.

pmc-12628829.title: Breaking the cycle: long-term socio economic determinants of child labour in SAARC countries
pmc-12628829.creator: Tharaka Magammana, Himashi Muthugala, Amanda Bandara, Ayodhya Perera, Ruwan Jayathilaka
pmc-12628829.description: BackgroundChild labour remains a critical issue in SAARC countries, driven by various socio-economic factors. While previous studies have explored individual determinants, limited research has been conducted on their collective long-term impact. Understanding how structural and economic conditions shape child labour trends is essential for designing effective policy interventions.

pmc-13230924.title: Val109 and Ile170 contribute to channel function in Guillardia theta-derived anion channelrhodopsins
pmc-13230924.creator: Takanori Yokoyama, Eriko Sugano, Kitako Tabata, Taira Kakizaki, Shu Maruoka, Yuka Endo, Taku Ozaki, Tomokazu Fukuda, Lanlan Bai, Hiroshi Tomita
pmc-13230924.description: Anion channelrhodopsins (ACRs) are widely used for optical silencing of neurons. Photocurrents and kinetics are crucial for the precise control of cell hyperpolarization. In this study, we investigated the roles of amino acid residues in each transmembrane domain of the Guillardia theta-derived anion channelrhodopsins, GtACR1 and GtACR2, to develop high-performance ACRs.

pmc-13245054.title: The impact of pediatric influenza and COVID-19 hospitalization on parental attitudes toward vaccination
pmc-13245054.creator: Piotr Rzymski, Barbara Szczepańska, Zuzanna Wasielewska, Małgorzata Pawłowska, Kamila Cywińska, Jan Świerczynski, Anna Dobrzeniecka, Ilona Małecka, Barbara Poniedziałek, Robert Flisiak, Dorota Zarębska-Michaluk
pmc-13245054.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Hospitalization for vaccine-preventable infections may influence parental vaccination attitudes, but comparative data for influenza and COVID-19 are limited. We conducted a multicenter observational study of unvaccinated children hospitalized with influenza or COVID-19 in Poland. We collected clinical data and parental survey data assessing vaccination regret, future vaccination intentions, willingness to encourage others, interest in vaccination reminders, reasons for non-vaccination, and sources of influence. Parents of influenza-hospitalized children reported greater regret over non-vaccination (62.5% [45/72] vs.

pmc-13442862.title: Descriptor-guided thermodynamic screening of adsorption on single-atom-doped anatase nanoparticles with interpretable machine learning
pmc-13442862.creator: Mustafa Kurban, Can Polat, Erchin Serpedin, Hasan Kurban
pmc-13442862.description: Understanding how surface dopants tune adsorption on oxide nanoparticles is important for the design of reversible hydrogen-storage materials and catalytic interfaces. Here, we present a descriptor-guided screening study of molecular adsorption on pristine and single-atom-doped anatase nanoparticles using density-functional tight-binding calculations, conceptual DFT descriptors, thermodynamic modelling, and interpretable machine learning.

pmc-13491628.title: Enhancing the degradation of cellulose and hemicellulose in chili pepper straw waste using Cellulomonas iranensis 7–12, which was isolated from naturally decayed chili pepper straw
pmc-13491628.creator: Mengting Chen, Zhiye Tian, Jiaya Chen, Xiaoping Li, Yongjun Wu, Xilong Shen, Shuoqiu Tong, Jin Jin, Cen Li, Meng Zhao, Liangcai Xiong, Sana Gul, Lintao Ren, Lincheng Zhang
pmc-13491628.description: The sustainable valorization of agricultural waste, such as chili pepper straw, is often challenged by the absence of effective microbes that can degrade cell wall components. In this study, metagenomic analysis found that Pseudomonadota was the dominant phylum in the carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC)-enriched microbial communities.

pmc-13628680.title: The hidden hazard in every sip: tackling microplastics in drinking water through detection and mitigation
pmc-13628680.creator: Sadia Younis, Syed Ali Hassan, Tehmina Naseem, Khushi Ali, Muhammad Irfan, Mueen Abbas, Muhammad Asif, Nabila Aslam, Syed Junaid Zafar, Maryam Abbasi Tarighat, Gholamreza Abdi
pmc-13628680.description: Microplastics (MPs), recognized as contaminants of emerging concern, have become global in drinking water systems, posing increasing risks to food safety, public health, and environmental sustainability. As drinking water represents a major route of human exposure, understanding the occurrence, detection, and mitigation of MPs is essential.
